name: Well test facilities: test manifold with either a test separator or a multiphase flow meter
description: OilGasz states a test manifold routes a selected well to a test separator, an MPFM or other measurement equipment, and Emerson describes the Roxar 2600 MPFM as a compact vertical inline meter giving three-phase rates without separation across 0-100% GVF and 0-100% WLR.
aliases: Well test facilities: test manifold with either a test separator or a multiphase flow meter (MPFM)

specifications.metric: Roxar 2600 Multiphase Flow Meter — available sizes
specifications.basis: Roxar 2600 MPFM available in 6 sizes, with materials from duplex stainless steel to Inconel and enclosures in SS316 or painted aluminum

specifications.metric: Roxar 2600 Multiphase Flow Meter — gas volume fraction range
specifications.basis: Both gamma and non-gamma versions deliver reliable performance across 0-100% GVF and 0-100% WLR

specifications.metric: Roxar 2600 Multiphase Flow Meter — water liquid ratio range
specifications.basis: 0-100% WLR operating envelope printed on Emerson multiphase flow page

specifications.metric: Roxar 2600 Multiphase Flow Meter — measurement update rate
specifications.basis: Phase fraction and flow rate calculations at high resolution of 10 times a second

specifications.metric: Roxar 2600 Multiphase Flow Meter — field experience
specifications.basis: Emerson states over 30 years of field experience and a global presence for its MPFMs

specifications.metric: Vx Spectra surface multiphase flowmeter — high-GVF threshold
specifications.basis: Triple-energy source improves liquid rates and water/liquid ratio at GVF greater than 95%

specifications.metric: Test separator / test manifold — test separator vs MPFM trade-off
specifications.basis: Test separators may offer lower uncertainty in controlled conditions; MPFMs provide higher operational efficiency and reduce space, weight and piping
Typical recommendation is yearly checks and verification; calibration verified using test separator data or sampling
Roxar 2600 has no moving parts, reducing wear and maintenance needs and the need for spare parts
